category: routing, geocoding and route optimization API

free_tier.stated: Free plan, EUR 0 a month,: 500 credits per day with 5 locations a routing request; a geocoding request costs 0.3 credit on the default provider and 0.9 credit on nominatim or opencagedata, so 500 credits cover about 1,666 default-provider geocodes a day (500 / 0.3)
free_tier.notes: credits are shared with the routing, matrix, isochrone and optimization APIs; the Free plan has a limited credit count per minute and carries no guarantees

per_object_cap.stated: no batch geocoding endpoint: one query a GET request; 5 locations a routing request on the Free plan

egress.terms: not applicable: a query API metered in credits, not bytes

interface_detail: HTTPS GET to graphhopper.com/api/1/geocode (q, locale, limit, reverse, point and provider parameters) with the key as a query parameter; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 No API key specified; the provider parameter is under development and can fall back to the default at any time
chaining: 500 credits a day, about 1,666 default-provider geocodes, on a non-commercial email account with no card, shared with routing and optimization calls

limits.value: 500 credits a day on the Free plan; a geocoding request costs 0.3 credit (default) or 0.9 credit (nominatim, opencagedata)
a limited credit count per minute on the Free plan, size not published; HTTP 429 answers when the daily or per-minute limit is exhausted
5 locations a request on the Free plan (routing)

binding_note: the per-minute credit limit of the Free plan is not published, so the 500-credit day is the figure that binds

identity_cost.detail: an account at graphhopper.com/dashboard/signup with a first name, last name, email, password, company and country and a terms checkbox; GraphHopper activates the access and notifies the subscriber by email; the pricing page says no credit card is required

reliability_note: the Free plan carries no guarantees; past the daily or per-minute limit the API answers HTTP 429; the provider parameter can fall back to the default at any time
confidence_note: the pricing page, the credit FAQ, the OpenAPI docs, the terms, the per-minute limit article and the sign-up page were quoted on 2026-11-02; a keyless geocode answered HTTP 401. No account was opened, so the free daily credits and the per-minute limit of the Free plan were not exercised.
